topic: In chapter 1194 Zoro finally masters Conqueror's Haki against Saint Sommers by remembering Mihawk's old lesson
title: Zoro's Conqueror's Haki Finally Makes Sense (1194)
description: Chapter 1194 finally answers why Zoro kept losing control of his Conqueror's Haki against Saint Sommers. The old lesson from Mihawk was hiding in plain sight the whole time. Do you think Oda planned this since Zoro first met Mihawk?
comment: Did Mihawk know Zoro needed this lesson, or did Zoro figure it out alone? Pick one.

lines.text: Zoro finally cracked the one lesson Mihawk gave him years ago.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman radiating a dark aura, three swords on his hip

lines.text: In chapter 1194, Saint Sommers cornered him and mocked his out of control power.

shot.fallback: cruel armored celestial knight sneering down at an opponent

lines.text: Zoro sliced him into pieces, but Sommers just regenerated every single time.

shot.fallback: swordsman slicing through an armored figure, sparks flying

lines.text: That is when the old memory hit him.

shot.fallback: swordsman with closed eyes remembering the past, faded lighting

lines.text: Mihawk once told him Conqueror's Haki is not about strength. It is about sensing your own.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman speaking sternly to a young student

lines.text: The moment Zoro actually believed that, the Haki stopped slipping away.

shot.search: Zoro dark haki aura eyes glowing
shot.fallback: swordsman engulfed in dark energy, eyes glowing

lines.text: He coated his blade on command. No hesitation, no leaks.

shot.fallback: black coated katana glowing with dark energy

lines.text: And for the first time, Sommers stopped laughing.

shot.fallback: armored tyrant staggering back in shock

lines.text: Here's why this moment matters more than the fight itself.

shot.fallback: close up of a scarred swordsman's determined face

lines.text: Every time Zoro almost unlocked this power before, fear got in the way.

shot.fallback: two swordsmen sparring on a misty island

lines.text: This time Oda showed him choosing control over rage.

shot.fallback: swordsman unleashing a massive slicing technique

lines.text: That is the real difference between Zoro and tyrants like Sommers who rule through fear.

shot.fallback: swordsman standing tall over a fallen armored tyrant

lines.text: So maybe Mihawk always knew exactly what Zoro needed to hear.

shot.fallback: stoic swordsman staring into the distance

lines.text: Zoro finally cracked the one lesson Mihawk gave him...

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman smirking with sword raised

self_check.hook: leads with Zoro and the claim in under 2 seconds
self_check.loop: final line repeats line 1's opening clause so it flows back into it
